items.title: fix(heartbeat): deliver exec completions with disabled cadence (#126895)
items.summary: fix(heartbeat): deliver exec completions with disabled cadence (#126895) With agents.defaults.heartbeat.every set to "0m", a background exec completion queued its system event and requested a targeted exec-event wake, but the shared unscheduled-wake policy only admitted immediate wakes, so the follow-up agent turn silently never ran. Admit the exact exec-event/event producer shape (session or agent target required) in one per-source predicate, dispatch wake timers outside the requesting attempt's transcript-writer context, and document that "0m" disables recurring cadence only. Closes #62505 Co-authored-by: Jason O'Neal Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
